title: Nourishing Light Russian Eggs Frittata
description: A garlicky and crumbly Russian dish featuring free-range eggs, this frittata is a diabetic-friendly option for a nutritious meal. It is made with wholesome ingredients and is perfect for a light breakfast or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, garlic, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill, grated cheddar cheese, and chopped scallions.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
